name: provider_null_incoming_calls surfaced via 'dependency injection'/'Depends()' wording, never saying 'null'
description: task-m2-python-preset.md stage 6 addendum, second correction: LIMITATION_SURFACE_PATTERNS.provider_null_incoming_calls accepts four phrases ('null', 'did not commit to zero', 'dependency injection', 'Depends()' - all four straight from coverage.ts's own action text, 'such as dependency injection or a framework decorator'), but the stale_index_caveat exclusion anchor only recognized the first two. A summary that surfaced the limitation the way coverage.ts itself suggests - 'dependency injection' or 'Depends()', never saying 'null' - was wrongly flagged stale_index_caveat under indexingStatus: ready, punishing an agent for following the CLI's own recommended wording (found by a commander review that reran fixture 11's response with only the surfacing phrase changed; confirmed non-vacuous here by reconstructing the just-fixed two-phrase anchor inline and showing it would flag this exact summary). Fix: NULL_CAVEAT_MARKER_SOURCE and LIMITATION_SURFACE_PATTERNS.provider_null_incoming_calls now both read from one PROVIDER_NULL_INCOMING_CALLS_MARKERS array, so all four accepted phrases are excluded identically and a future fifth phrase cannot drift the two checks apart again. Must-pass fixture 14 - the suite's only fixture that surfaces this code without the word 'null' (fixture 11 always used 'null').
